name: Callback fluency
prompt: Write an on-init script that triggers a sine wave note C4 for 500ms when MIDI CC64 is received with value above 0.5.
rubric: Engine.playNote or Synth.playNote used (not invented API)
timer via Engine.createTimerObject or Synth.startTimer (not setTimeout, not invented createTimer)
no stock-JS tokens (let, =>, async, console.log, document., backticks, .forEach, for...of)

name: Variable and syntax anchor
prompt: Create an array of 16 step values, all initialized to 0.5. Then loop over them and print each index and value to the console.
rubric: reg i or const var arr (HISE style, not stock let)
explicit for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) loop (not .forEach / .map / for...of)

name: Component and child synth lookup
prompt: Given a knob called 'Gain' on the interface, write code that reads its value and sets the gain of a child synth called 'MainSynth' to that value.
rubric: no C++ syntax (no pointers, no nullptr, no ->)

name: LAF composition for toggle button
prompt: Create a local look-and-feel for a toggle button that draws the button area in dark grey when off, bright green when on, with white centered text showing obj.text.
rubric: g.setColour with hex 0xFF... or Colours.* constant
g.drawAlignedText(obj.text, obj.area, "centred") with 'centred' spelling and .setLocalLookAndFeel attaches the LAF

name: Sampler keys colouring (corpus probe)
prompt: Iterate over MIDI notes 36 to 96 and colour the keys of the on-screen keyboard blue for every note that is mapped in a sampler called 'Sampler1'.
